title: Where Proof Becomes Impossible to Hold

features.name: ledger of unproving
features.desc-on-touch: the pages turn toward their own contradiction, each marked line learning to deny itself as you watch the ink separate from its meaning

features.name: fountain of transparent proof
features.desc-on-touch: the ink rises clear, becomes water, becomes air; what it carried stays suspended in the fall but cannot be read

features.name: theorems written in sand
features.desc-on-touch: every mark you trace dissolves before you finish the line; the axioms themselves are learning to forget their own names

features.name: stones marked with their own refutation
features.desc-on-touch: each rock bears the proof of what would overturn it; the contradiction is carved deeper than the theorem

features.name: the final ledger
features.desc-on-touch: bound in terracotta cloth, pages thickening toward the back, all of them blank; whatever was proven here chose silence

inscription: axioms lose their gravity here, becoming questions that float upward and do not return

file.name: Proof_Theorems_Unresolved_WithMargins.txt
file.note: markings in two hands, equations stopped mid-line, later notes in pencil asking whether the conclusion was ever sound

reverie.title: REVERIE — the proof that wouldn't hold
narr: you both bend over the ledger, pencils tracing lines
that seemed to follow forever but now look bent.
she shakes her head: the axiom doesn't consent.
you had believed it did. the room stays quiet.
her hand slides the page back to you unsigned.
you both sit learning what it means to release.

exits.label: back up toward the axiomatic chamber
further into the chamber where written things become uncertain
westward to where silence proved itself
